desc:
🩸 BRUTALIZE RAGDOLLS 🩸

💥 Smash, slice and Shoot ragdolls with real physics!
🏭🏗️🏙️ Fight waves of sword-swinging enemies in the Warehouse, Construction Site and Rooftops
⚔️ 30+ weapons: swords 🗡️, bows 🏹, shotguns 🔫, chainsaws 🪚 and rockets 
💰 Finish missions to earn cash, then gear up at 3 shops
🔓 Unlock new shopkeepers and maps as you go
🧱 Blocky gore everywhere: limbs fly, heads pop, bodies SPLAT from high up!

🩸 Slice, smash and SPLAT ragdolls with 30+ weapons across 3 brutal maps! ⚔️

New Missions and Shopkeepers coming soon!!
